diagnostic_conclusion.summary: The three frozen metamorphic failures are explained by two deterministic JavaScript/TypeScript frontend extraction defects. Pair 1 is a reserved-keyword parenthesis false CALL. Pairs 2 and 3 are the same shorthand-field false-positive mechanism whose visible arity changes depend on identifier-name collisions in the signature's unique field-name set.

diagnoses.mechanism: CALL_RE accepts any MEMBER followed by an opening parenthesis. The extraction loop excludes only if/for/while/switch/function, not return. Therefore the variant's `return (` is emitted as a spurious CALL with callee `return`; the base has no corresponding parenthesis and emits no such CALL.
diagnoses.why_individual_case_still_passed: The frozen R2 case expectation requires exactly one COMPARE and its semantic operands/operator, but does not assert CALL count zero. The metamorphic signature is what exposes the extra cross-kind fact.

diagnoses.mechanism: SHORTHAND_RE is applied across the whole object body instead of only to syntactic top-level property segments. An identifier on the RHS immediately before `,` or `}` can therefore be emitted as a shorthand FIELD_BIND. In the base nested `stamp: token }`, `token` becomes a false shorthand field in addition to the real fields. In the variant `stamp: stamp }`, the analogous false shorthand label is `stamp`, which collides with the real nested field name `stamp`. The signature deduplicates representation field names with a set, so five FIELD_BIND facts become five unique names in the base but four unique names in the variant.
diagnoses.why_individual_case_still_passed: The frozen object-return expectation requires the intended fields as a subset and exact RETURN ownership, but does not require absence of extra FIELD_BIND labels. Metamorphic arity detects the instability.

diagnoses.mechanism: The same whole-body SHORTHAND_RE misclassification emits RHS identifiers as fields. In the base, false shorthand labels include `chosen` and `applied`; `applied` collides with the real property key `applied`, yielding five unique representation field names from six FIELD_BIND facts. In the variant, false labels `selected` and `stored` collide with neither real property key, yielding six unique names from the same six FIELD_BIND facts.
diagnoses.why_individual_case_still_passed: The intended verdict/effect/guard/applied fields are present, so subset-based object-return validation passes even though extra field facts exist. The preregistered metamorphic signature correctly rejects the name-sensitive over-emission.

checker_scope_note.reason: Both qualification checkers independently compute expectations and signatures, but both consume the same versioned frontend_js_v2 extraction surface. Their agreement corroborates checker-level detection, not an independently implemented frontend parser.

scientific_interpretation.interpretation: The first complete FAIL should remain a scientific FAIL. The gate revealed real semantic over-emission that the per-case positive/subset obligations did not forbid. This strengthens rather than weakens the value of the prospective metamorphic gate.

recommended_next_boundary.recommended_versioning: Do not rewrite the frozen v0.2 implementation bytes. Introduce a new versioned remediation surface after preregistration.
generic_remediation_targets: CALL recognition must reject standalone reserved-keyword pseudo-callees while preserving legal member calls such as obj.return().

Object FIELD_BIND extraction must parse structural property segments at the relevant brace depth. Shorthand emission must require an entire property segment to be a shorthand identifier, never merely an RHS identifier before comma/brace.
New remediation qualification should include regression checks for the now-known failure mechanisms plus newly frozen generic metamorphic cases that are not derived from frozen 48/58 target bytes.
